definitions.full: H3642. kamah כָּמַהּ verb faint (Arabic is be pale of face, gray (of daylight), weak-eyed , blind from birth ; Syriac be blind ), only figurative — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳כ בְשָׂרִי לְךָ Psa 63:2 faint (with longing) for thee (|| נַפְשִׁי לְךָ צָֽמְאָה ).
